# GRDC Agroecozones

```{r}
#| label: map
#| echo: false

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(ozmaps)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggspatial)

# 1. Read the data and project it (GDA2020 / Australian Albers, metres)
aez <- readRDS("aez.Rds") |> st_transform(9473)
aus <- ozmap_data() |> st_transform(9473)

# 2. Neighbours: zones within 1 m of each other count as touching
nb <- st_is_within_distance(aez, aez, dist = 1)
nb <- Map(setdiff, nb, seq_along(nb))

# 3. Exact colouring; prefers the least-used colour to keep things balanced
colour_exact <- function(nb, k) {
  n <- length(nb)
  ord <- order(-lengths(nb))
  col <- rep(NA_integer_, n)
  solve <- function(pos) {
    if (pos > n) {
      return(TRUE)
    }
    i <- ord[pos]
    ok <- setdiff(seq_len(k), col[nb[[i]]])
    ok <- ok[order(tabulate(col[!is.na(col)], k)[ok])]
    for (cc in ok) {
      col[i] <<- cc
      if (solve(pos + 1)) {
        return(TRUE)
      }
    }
    col[i] <<- NA
    FALSE
  }
  if (solve(1)) col else NULL
}

for (k in 2:6) {
  ids <- colour_exact(nb, k)
  if (!is.null(ids)) break
}
aez$colour_id <- ids

# 4. Okabe-Ito: sky blue, orange, reddish purple (yellow as a spare)
all_cols <- unname(palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito"))
pal <- lighten(all_cols[c(3, 2, 8, 5)], 0.2)[seq_len(k)]

# 5. Label positions
xy <- st_coordinates(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(aez)))
lab <- data.frame(AEZ = as.character(aez$AEZ), x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2])

# Zones labelled outside with a pointer. dx/dy move the label away from the
# zone's label point, in km (east and north positive). Any zone not listed
# here is labelled inside its own polygon.
move <- data.frame(
  AEZ = c(
    "Qld Atherton",
    "Qld Burdekin",
    "NSW NE/Qld SE",
    "NSW NW/Qld SW",
    "Tas Grain",
    "Vic High Rainfall",
    "SA Vic Bordertown-Wimmera",
    "SA Midnorth-Lower Yorke Eyre",
    "WA Sandplain",
    "WA Northern",
    "WA Central",
    "WA Eastern"
  ),
  dx = c(450, 450, 450, -450, 420, -300, -250, -200, 0, -450, -800, 0),
  dy = c(0, 0, 0, 0, -80, -300, -420, -420, -420, 0, 0, 450)
)
lab <- merge(lab, move, by = "AEZ", all.x = TRUE)
lab$outside <- !is.na(lab$dx)

# Line breaks: always after "/", otherwise by width (wider outside the zones)
wrap <- function(z, w) {
  parts <- strsplit(z, "(?<=/)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  paste(unlist(lapply(parts, strwrap, width = w)), collapse = "\n")
}
lab$text <- mapply(wrap, lab$AEZ, ifelse(lab$outside, 18, 12))

lab_in <- subset(lab, !outside)
lab_out <- subset(lab, outside)

# 6. Map (no legend: fills only separate neighbours, they carry no meaning)
# Plot window from the mainland and Tasmania only (parts bigger than 50,000 km2),
# so far-off islands such as Macquarie Island don't stretch the map
parts <- st_cast(st_cast(st_geometry(aus), "MULTIPOLYGON"), "POLYGON")
bb_main <- st_bbox(parts[as.numeric(st_area(parts)) > 5e10])

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "#F1E9D2") +
  geom_sf(
    data = aez,
    aes(fill = factor(colour_id)),
    colour = "#FAF8E9",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
  # labels that fit inside their zone
  geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_in,
    aes(x, y, label = text),
    size = 2.6,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    bg.color = "#FAF8E9",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    force = 0, # labels stay put: repel is only used for its halo
    min.segment.length = Inf,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  # labels placed outside: a dot marks the zone, a line points to the label
  geom_point(data = lab_out, aes(x, y), size = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_out,
    aes(x, y, label = text),
    nudge_x = lab_out$dx * 1000,
    nudge_y = lab_out$dy * 1000,
    size = 2.6,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    bg.color = "#FAF8E9",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.colour = "grey25",
    box.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1
  ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "bl",
    which_north = "true",
    pad_x = unit(0.4, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.4, "in"),
    height = unit(1.4, "cm"),
    width = unit(1.4, "cm"),
    style = north_arrow_orienteering()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The GRDC Agroecological Zones of Australia",
    caption = "Data: GRDC agroecological zones (CC BY 4.0)"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb_main["xmin"] - 600e3, bb_main["xmax"] + 450e3),
    ylim = c(bb_main["ymin"] - 150e3, bb_main["ymax"] + 100e3),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#7EB5C2")
  )
```

This repository contains geospatial data files that contain the GRDC's agroecozone classifications in EPSG:4326 (unprojected) as:

- [geopackage (.gpkg) file](https://github.com/AAGI-AUS/GRDC_AEZ/raw/refs/heads/main/aez.gpkg),
- [shapefile](https://github.com/AAGI-AUS/GRDC_AEZ/raw/refs/heads/main/shapefile.zip), and
- [native R .Rds](https://github.com/AAGI-AUS/GRDC_AEZ/raw/refs/heads/main/aez.Rds) file providing an {sf} object with the AEZ field as a `factor`.
